cryptoTrack.operations.unavailable: The crypto operations are not ready yet.
cryptoTrack.operations.title: Crypto operations
cryptoTrack.operations.pageHint: The operations of every connected address. They come from the network and are never typed in.
cryptoTrack.operations.readonlyNote: Operations come from the network. They cannot be added or deleted: the list is read again on every refresh. Only their meaning can change: the category, the description, the counterparty and the exchange.
cryptoTrack.operations.emptyHint: Nothing is typed in by hand here. Once an address is connected in a wallet of the Crypto kind, the engine fills this list after its first read of the network and keeps it up to date while the vault is open.
cryptoTrack.operations.emptyFilteredHint: Reset the filter or change the address in the search.
cryptoTrack.operations.noLink: This operation has no page in a browser.
cryptoTrack.operations.openFailed: Could not open the page in the browser
cryptoTrack.operations.saved: The meaning of the operation is saved
cryptoTrack.operations.hiddenToast: The operation is hidden from the totals
cryptoTrack.operations.shownToast: The operation counts in the totals again
cryptoTrack.operations.linked: The operation is linked to the fiat one: it is an exchange
cryptoTrack.operations.banner.title: Looks like an exchange
cryptoTrack.operations.banner.body: On {date} {spent} left the wallet «{place}» — it looks like the payment for {got}. You decide: the app links nothing by itself.
cryptoTrack.operations.exchangeDialog.hi: We will link the receipt with the operation that paid for it. The sums do not change.
cryptoTrack.operations.exchangeDialog.se: Search by wallet, sum or date
cryptoTrack.operations.exchangeDialog.pi: Choose the operation that paid for it
cryptoTrack.operations.exchangeDialog.no: There is no ordinary-currency spending close by in date. Add the expense in the right wallet and come back.
cryptoTrack.operations.exchangeDialog.ca: The app only suggests: the link appears after «Link». You can break it in the operation card.
cryptoTrack.operations.reason.amountFits: the sum fits the rate — {rate} {currency} per {symbol}
cryptoTrack.operations.meaning.title: Meaning of the operation
cryptoTrack.operations.meaning.hint: The operation came from the network: its sum is not editable.
cryptoTrack.operations.meaning.categoryH: The categories are the same as for ordinary operations: one directory, there is no second list for crypto.
cryptoTrack.operations.meaning.rememberH: The address {address} will be remembered for this contact: the next operations from it name themselves.
cryptoTrack.operations.meaning.readonly: The sum, the rate and the balance come from the network and are not editable here: only the meaning of the operation changes.
cryptoTrack.operations.meaning.contractA: Apply to every operation of this contract ({count})
cryptoTrack.operations.filter.hidden: Show operations hidden from the totals
cryptoTrack.operations.detail.subtitle: operation from the network · read only
cryptoTrack.operations.detail.readonly: The sum, the rate and the balance come from the network and are not editable.
cryptoTrack.operations.detail.gasNote: The network fee was paid by the sender or the wallet: the chain counts the exchanger's fee, not the gas.
cryptoTrack.operations.detail.basisFromC: The cost comes from the linked operation, not from the market price of the day.
tour.cryptoOperations.list.title: Operations from the network
tour.cryptoOperations.list.body: Everything the module read from your address. An operation cannot be added, edited in its sum or deleted: the list is read from the network again. Press a row for its card, or «⋯» for actions.
tour.cryptoOperations.override.title: Meaning of the operation
tour.cryptoOperations.override.body: The category, the description and «through whom» are a correction laid over the operation. The sums stay as the network gave them, and the correction survives a refresh.
tour.cryptoOperations.link.title: The page in an explorer
tour.cryptoOperations.link.body: The button opens the operation's page in your browser, and only when pressed: until then the explorer learns nothing about you.
whatsNew.cryptoOperations.title: Crypto operations in a wallet
whatsNew.cryptoOperations.list: The «Operations» tab of a wallet of the Crypto kind lists the address's operations by day. They cannot be added or deleted: they come from the network. The filter by network, token, protocol, kind and address is kept in the page address.
whatsNew.cryptoOperations.exchange: «This is an exchange» links the coins that arrived with the roubles or dollars that left, into one chain. The app only suggests similar operations and never links by itself; the link can be broken.
whatsNew.cryptoOperations.meaning: An operation can get a category, a description and a counterparty, be hidden from the totals, or open its page in an explorer — only on a click.
cryptoTrack.operations.own.openingNote: This is not an operation of the chain but what the address held before the start date you chose: the history before it is not read, and the count begins from this number.
cryptoTrack.operations.own.reconciliatio: This is not an operation of the chain but a correction towards the balance the network itself reports: the chain is the authority, and this entry makes the total agree with it.
cryptoTrack.operations.notExchangeToast: We will not suggest an exchange for this one again
